lines: The messengers arrived with the queen's treasure.
And Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, said: "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allah has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift."
He sent them back with it.
And the queen set out herself, to come to him.
Then Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, asked his court something that sounds impossible.
